summary: Iteration 5 verifies the app after two config-only deployment changes: (1) supervisor 'expo start --tunnel' flag + @expo/ngrok installed and (2) EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL flipped from .preview.emergentagent.com to .ngrok.io. No application code was changed. Both backend and frontend re-verified end-to-end against the public preview URL. Backend: 40/40 pytest cases PASS (test_stompin_backend.py, test_instructor_features.py, test_scheduler_idempotency.py). Direct curl checks against the public URL confirm: GET /api/venue 200, GET /api/dances returns exactly 101 published dances, GET /api/dances/{id} 200, POST /api/auth/login as Erin 200 (token issued, /auth/me returns is_admin=true, is_instructor=true), /api/classes?scope=upcoming|past 200, /api/attendance/me 200, /api/suggestions 200, /api/chat/messages 200 for instructor, POST /api/register-push 500 with 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' (expected placeholder-key behaviour), POST /api/dances/import bulk 200 (imported:1), PUT /api/dances/{id}/publish and /unpublish both 200 (route uses PUT not POST — review request omitted the verb; confirmed against server.py). All TEST_* seed rows created during testing were deleted; final published dance count remains 101. Frontend (Playwright, mobile viewport 390x844) against the public URL confirms: /auth screen loads with logo hero + Sign In/Create Account tabs + Continue with Google. Erin login → home renders 'Howdy, Erin!' + Fresh on the Floor + Recent Class Recap + Suggest widget, and bottom nav has 5 tabs [Home, Dances, My Dances, Instructor, Profile]. Instructor tab draft-count badge shows '1' when a single TEST_DraftBadge_iter5 draft exists. Instructor screen renders header 'Instructor', sub-tabs Dances/Classes/Chat, and the CSV + '+ New' buttons on the Dances sub-tab; draft dance card shows beginner + 'No sheet' + 'Draft' pills + 'Sheet' + 'Publish' buttons. Library shows all 101 dances via infinite list with difficulty chips (All/Beginner/Improver/Intermediate/Advanced) and search filter (typing 'cowboy' correctly filters to Cowboy Cha Cha + Save a Horse). Dance detail screen (dance-card-* → /dance/{id}) shows Beginner badge, name, choreographer, SONG/ARTIST/BPM/COUNT tiles, 'Watch Tutorial on YouTube' button, 'Step Sheet' with prefilled 8-count block, Edit button, and Wishlist / Mark Completed CTAs. Classes screen renders Upcoming/Past Recap tabs + Log button. Suggest screen renders New/Mine (0)/All (0) tabs with full submit form (Dance Name, Song, Artist, difficulty chips, YouTube URL, Notes, Send to Erin). Profile screen renders EB avatar, name, email, Admin badge, stats (0/0/0/—), Account rows (Instructor Tab, Log a Class, Review Suggestions, Sign Out). Fresh regular user (TEST_reg_1784216152@example.com) sees only 4 tabs [Home, Dances, My Dances, Profile] — Instructor tab correctly hidden — and hitting /instructor directly shows the 'Instructors only.' locked screen. Only non-blocking issue: pre-existing 'expo-notifications listener not supported on web' warnings (expected on web preview, not affecting native builds). Tunnel + env changes did not regress anything.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' Non-blocking; expected on Expo web preview and will not fire on native builds. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx

action_items: None blocking. Deployment green-light from a functional standpoint after the tunnel + ngrok proxy URL flip.

Note for main agent: review-request lists /api/dances/{id}/publish and /unpublish without an HTTP verb — actual implementation is PUT, not POST. Confirmed via server.py:520/533 and verified 200 responses. Any client caller must use PUT.
critical_code_review_comments: supervisord.conf now launches Metro with `yarn expo start --tunnel --port 3000`; @expo/ngrok is installed and Expo can boot the tunnel successfully — expo supervisord program is RUNNING and localhost:3000 + public URL both return 200.

frontend/.env EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL now points to https://stompin-yuma-app.ngrok.io while EXPO_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME and EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL still point to the .preview.emergentagent.com host. Backend calls in the app continue to succeed against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, so the proxy split is not affecting API traffic.

server.py send_push still swallows the 401 from the placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY gracefully — /api/register-push returns HTTP 500 with a clear 'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid' message (expected placeholder behaviour, not a real bug).

success_rate.backend: 100% (40/40 pytest + all review-request curl checks incl. bulk import + PUT publish/unpublish)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (auth screen, Erin login, home, library search+filter, dance detail with step sheet + YouTube button, my dances, classes upcoming/past, suggest New/Mine/All, profile, instructor tab visible + Dances/Classes/Chat sub-tabs + New/CSV buttons + draft-count badge '1', regular user has Instructor tab hidden + /instructor gate)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_DraftBadge_iter5, TEST_PubDance_iter5, TEST_PubDance_iter5b, TEST_ImportDance_iter5 dances during testing — all deleted via DELETE /api/dances/{id}. Registered one fresh regular user TEST_reg_1784216152@example.com to verify Instructor-tab hiding for non-instructors (kept — no DELETE user endpoint). Final /api/dances count re-verified at 101.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Config-only iteration confirmed non-regressive. testIDs to remember: brand-logo (auth), home-browse-cta, home-see-all, home-suggest-cta, home-classes-cta, home-dance-<id> (home feed), library-search, filter-chip-{all|beginner|improver|intermediate|advanced}, dance-card-<id>. On /auth there are TWO 'Sign In' text nodes (tab + submit) — click the LAST occurrence. Bottom nav for instructor has 5 tabs [Home, Dances, My Dances, Instructor, Profile]; for regular user only [Home, Dances, My Dances, Profile]. Instructor tab badge renders a red circle with the unpublished-draft count over the icon (verified with count=1). Publish/unpublish routes are PUT verbs, not POST.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no issues introduced by the tunnel/ngrok config changes. All prior features remain functional. The only 500 seen (/api/register-push) is intentional and gated by the placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY, per main-agent context note.
